singleSourced.context: "Prepare for even more adventures filled with new friends, new abilities, and new ferocious foes!" Team Cherry has repeatedly confirmed plans for post-launch Silksong support, but other than this upcoming DLC, we don't really know what that entails.
As part of the DLC announcement, Team Cherry said Hollow Knight: Silksong had sold more than 7 million copies since going on sale in September 2025, and had millions more playing on Xbox Game Pass.
